title: Framework upgrade
desiredOutcome: The storefront runs on the supported framework line, so the security fixes the audit depends on are actually available.
summary: The storefront moved to the supported framework line. This phase was finished BEFORE the audit plugin was adopted here, so nothing in it carries a recorded run — the surfaces say `Before recording` rather than `No evidence`, and the no-test-evidence gate excuses it rather than failing it.

outcome.technical: New entry point; compatibility shim deleted; 1 regression test.
outcome.descriptive: The storefront boots on the supported framework line.
